title: fix: validate user creation payload with Zod schema
head: xiaofengzii:fix/user-validation-5754
body:
## Summary
This PR adds Zod schema validation for user creation payloads.

## Changes
- Add `createUserSchema` in `apps/api/src/validators/user.js` accepting only `name`, `email`, and `password`
- Validate payload in `userController.js` and return 400 for invalid payloads
- System fields (id) are server-assigned
- Add tests for valid input, missing fields, invalid email, short password, and extra fields

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/user.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5754
